title: Port Health Station Contact List | Port Health | CDC
content: Port Health Station Contact List May 15, 2024 At a glance Each CDC Port Health Station has responsibility for enforcing CDC's quarantine regulations at all ports of entry within its assigned area of jurisdiction. CDC Port Health Stations and their Jurisdictions View Larger U.S. Port Health Stations are located at 20 ports of entry and land border crossings where international travelers arrive. This color-coded map shows the 20 Port Health Stations and their jurisdictions. Please note that all numbers operate with 24-hour access , unless an alternate number is provided. Shipping note : For shipping to port health stations using a delivery service other than FedEx (such as UPS, DHL or freight), confirm the correct shipping address prior to sending. Time zones : All hours of operation are based on the local time of the station's geographical location.
